name: Reynolds Cahoon
role: Missionary and temple building committee member
dateNote: He was baptized in November 1830 and joined the Kirtland temple building committee in June 1833.
importance: Section 52 sends him to Missouri with Samuel H. Smith, and section 61 tells the two to stay together. Section 75 pairs him with Hyrum Smith. Section 94 names him with Hyrum Smith and Jared Carter to build the Lord’s houses in Kirtland. He later served on the Nauvoo Temple building committee.
connections: He married Thirza Stiles in 1810. He worked with Hyrum Smith and Jared Carter and served as counselor to Bishop Newel K. Whitney.

sources.title: Reynolds Cahoon, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 30 Apr. 1790, Cambridge, New York; baptized by Parley P. Pratt Nov. 1830; high priest 4 June 1831; counselor to Whitney 1832; Kirtland Temple committee June 1833; Adam-ondi-Ahman 1838; Nauvoo Temple committee; died 29 Apr. 1861, Salt Lake City (from obituary citation).
